subject.title: feat: add native inline widget support

question: Should native chats accept this isolated-WebView design as the supported security boundary for assistant-authored inline widgets?
rationale: Tests and screenshots establish behavior, but automation cannot decide whether the capability URL, WebView isolation, navigation, profile lifecycle, and recovery guarantees meet the repository's intended native security posture.

options.title: Approve after security review
options.body: Retain the proposed native architecture, remove the changelog edit, and merge after an owner verifies each platform's isolation and recovery invariants on the exact head.

options.title: Narrow the initial rollout
options.body: Enable only the native clients whose isolation and lifecycle behavior can be fully proven now, leaving other clients unadvertised until follow-up proof exists.

options.title: Keep browser-only rendering
options.body: Decline native execution of assistant-authored widgets and retain transcript text plus the existing Control UI rendering path.

recommendation.title: Approve after security review
recommendation.body: Retain the proposed native architecture, remove the changelog edit, and merge after an owner verifies each platform's isolation and recovery invariants on the exact head.

likelyOwner.reason: This person owns the branch's cross-platform design and has the strongest available context for the intended native capability and security contract.
